- Business description: DJ's Freight Broker LLC operates a secure internal logistics operations portal for freight brokerage staff managing customers, loads, carriers, quotes, commissions, onboarding, and approvals.
- Target audience: Authorized agents, operations managers, team managers, accounting staff, and administrators.
- Primary services: Freight operations management, customer and carrier management, quote and load oversight, commission tracking, invoice handling, onboarding, and internal approvals.
- Industries served: Freight brokerage and logistics operations.
- Geographic coverage: Not explicitly published; the portal supports route and shipment management across multiple lanes and service areas.

## Products / Services
- Load management for freight operations and shipment tracking.
- Carrier relationship management and service-area administration.
- Customer record management with credit and status tracking.
- Quote request handling and pricing workflow support.
- Commission tracking and payout monitoring.
- Invoice management and billing-related workflow support.
- Onboarding and document review for new and existing users.
- Internal approvals, notifications, and audit monitoring.

## AI Summary
DJ's Freight Broker LLC runs a secure operations portal built for freight brokerage teams that need to coordinate day-to-day logistics work from a single system. The platform is designed for authorized agents, operations managers, team managers, accounting staff, and administrators who manage leads, customers, carriers, quotes, loads, invoices, and commissions. Its core value comes from bringing essential freight brokerage workflows into one place, with built-in onboarding, document review, approvals, notifications, and audit visibility. The company’s value proposition is operational efficiency: teams can move faster, reduce manual handoffs, and keep account activity organized in a centralized environment. Organizations choose this platform for its workflow visibility, role-based access, and focus on brokerage operations rather than generic business software.
